fusions.name: Out of the Reeds
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target first, then strike for 14 damage and leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dusk Chorus
fusions.desc: A croaking howl fills a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, which deals 6 damage to everything caught in it, each with a 25% chance of [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Spring From Cover
fusions.desc: A sudden spring that carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Coiled and Waiting
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
